sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
On standby from the start of shift as the second guard was running late; remaining available for response calls and incidents during this period.
Second guard for the Morning Shift has arrived.
Commencing Charlie Route; patrolling and ensuring a visible presence along Queen Street.
Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear.
Welfare check at ANZ Bank, all clear.
Welfare check at Habits and Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, Mrs Higgins, Mid City and 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; full sweep completed within the area, all clear.
Remaining stationed at Aotea Square to show presence while awaiting response calls.
Arrived at the Top of Mayoral Drive check-in; full scope of the area ensuring no issues are present.
Welfare check along the Bledisloe Building alleyway, all clear.
Welfare check inside Atrium on Elliott, making our way up towards the Crowne Plaza Hotel, all clear.

Arrived at the Top of Victoria Street check-in; checked in on all stores within the location, no concerns identified. A few street vagrants present but no complaints raised. Remaining stationed here to provide additional support for any problematic issues.
Welfare check at The People's Barista, all clear.
Patrolling along Albert Street, conducting welfare checks on all stores and businesses along the way.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Customs Street and Albert Street check-in; thorough check completed within the area, heavy foot traffic from members of the public, no issues found.
Welfare check completed inside Woolworths Metro and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough around the area with quick stops in at stores and cafes.
Standing by at TK Square to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls. Ending Charlie Route.

Response message from Hollywood Bakery Wyndham Street reporting a young boy, possibly aged 13–16, who stole a pie and walked out of the store without paying; last seen heading up Albert Street towards Victoria Street. He was seen with two other minors of a similar age — one of the three purchased a pie, one neither stole nor purchased anything, and the third committed the theft.
Arrived at the response location; retrieved video footage of the individual who stole. (Footage on file.) On patrol in search of the group of minors.
Call from the static security guard at HQ requesting assistance to be tagged into the office.

Response call from Michael Hill reporting a very suspicious male individual who came in, tried to open their drawers and acted very inappropriately towards staff; he has come in multiple times over the past few days and is possibly a street vagrant. Description: cap worn backwards, black sunglasses, black shirt, khaki shorts; last seen heading up towards Queen Street. Staff advised to call us back immediately if the individual is seen nearby or returns to the store.
Arrived at HQ; standing by to assist the guard with whatever he may need.
Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; full sweep completed around the area, no issues found. Standing by for further response calls.
Response call from Danny, the Formery security guard, reporting a male individual sitting outside next to their building; assistance requested to move him along.

Call back from Danny calling off the removal — the individual had already got up and left. Attended and checked on the area regardless, and had a chat with the security guard before continuing patrols.
Welfare check inside Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street; stopped in to grab some drinks and checked up on the static guards, all clear.
Arrived at Elliott Street; ensuring a strong security presence within the location and conducting welfare checks on all stores.
Arrived at the Elliott Street Apartments check-in; welfare check inside Elliott Stables, all clear.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee and Father Teds, all clear.
Welfare check at Acceco Supermarket, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street check-in, no issues found. Commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses within the area.
Response call from Cotton On requesting assistance to move along a female individual sitting in front of their store.

Arrived at the Cotton On response location; asked the individual to move to a different location, and she complied without further issue, but shortly afterwards began yelling and cursing at the store.
Commencing welfare checks on High Street stores and businesses.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and the Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall, no concerns identified.
Arrived at the Chancery Square check-in; full sweep completed, ensuring no issues are present.
Arrived at the Wilson Carpark Fort Street check-in, no issues found. Welfare checks commenced on stores and the static guards present.
En route to HQ for lunch break.
Arrived at HQ; standing by for lunch while preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)

Arrived outside McDonald's Queen Street; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues or nearby response calls.
Leaving standby area; commencing patrols down towards TK Square. No issues occurred and no nearby response calls.

Arrived outside Peter Alexander; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, nothing to report. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Response call from Celine's regarding vagrants sitting outside their store; assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived at Celine's; the vagrants had already left the premises.

Arrived outside Hallensteins Queen Street; welfare check on stores within the area, nothing to report. Standing by for any nearby response calls while making our presence visible to surrounding businesses and members of the public.
While on standby, Hallensteins staff informed the team of a suspicious female individual who may be attempting to commit theft; standing by.
The individual has left the store; staff confirmed she had not taken anything. Continuing patrols.
Arrived at the Fort Street check-in; welfare check on stores.
Welfare check on stores within the Fort Street area complete, all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Departing standby area; no response calls or problematic issues occurred.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check on stores within the area.
Welfare check on stores complete, all clear, no issues reported. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues.
Response call from New Balance Queen Street regarding a suspicious female inside their store; presence requested.
Arrived at New Balance; staff advised she had gone into the fitting room with a shoe, shorts and a t-shirt. Standing by — appears to be the same person of interest from Hallensteins.
The female has left the store; the manager advised she tried to pay several times but her card kept declining (same person of interest from Hallensteins earlier). Standing by.
Departing standby area; heading up Queen Street.
Arrived outside Footlocker; standing by for security presence for members of the public and surrounding businesses.
Response message from Acceco regarding a male individual passing by their store — the same individual who stole from them on Sunday 1 November. Heading over to Acceco.
Arrived at Acceco; the male had already departed the area. (Photo on file.) Standing by.
Leaving standby area; heading back to HQ for a toilet break, light refreshments and floor checks.
Floor checks complete; standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage while remaining vigilant for response calls (percentage displayed on the office camera at 18:13).
Commencing patrols; Ops Phone at 34%, enough to last until the end of shift.
Standing by outside HQ for security presence; vagrancy presence is heavy within the area.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred.
Arrived at the corner of High Street; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, nothing to report.
Arrived at the Freyberg Square / Chancery Square check-in, all clear.
Full sweep of Chancery Square and Freyberg Square complete, no issues. Standing by for any nearby response calls or problematic issues within the area.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred and no nearby response calls.
Arrived at the Fort Street check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check on stores, all clear, no issues reported. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at the Albert Mart check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the St Patrick's Square check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the Federal Street check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the Top of Victoria Street West check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street and Victoria Street West; check-in on stores within the area, all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence and any nearby response calls.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred.
Arrived at the Bottom of Victoria Street West check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street and Victoria Street East; commencing a full sweep and welfare checks on stores.

Arrived at the Lorne Street fountain; welfare checks on stores complete, no issues, and full sweep complete, no issues. Standing by at the fountain for any nearby response calls while on the lookout for any problematic issues within the area.
Leaving standby area; no issues or response calls received.
Arrived at the Auckland Library check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Rutland Street and Queen Street; welfare check on stores within the area.
Welfare checks at the corner of Rutland Street and Queen Street complete, all clear, nothing to report. Heading back to HQ to stand by for shift handover.
Arrived at HQ; standing by for changeover to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store, no issues to report. Heading up upper Queen Street towards Aotea Square.
Welfare check at Father Teds, no issues to report. Incident on Wellesley Street — four Police cars just outside Lorne Street; on standby in case assistance is needed.
No need for our assistance; continuing patrol.
Upper Queen Street all clear, no issues to report.
Patrolling Aotea Square; commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete; on standby for any nearby calls.
All clear at Aotea Square, no nearby calls. Heading up Mayoral Drive.
Mayoral Drive and Wellesley Street all clear, no issues to report.
Federal Street all clear; welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Check-in at St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues to report.
On standby at Ace Karaoke showing presence.
Two large groups have left Ace Karaoke; no issues to report.
Welfare check at 11 Angels and Albert Mart, no issues to report.
Albert Street full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Quay Street; welfare checks conducted at Andrew Andrews and with the marina guards, no issues to report. Heading up Quay Street towards Commercial Bay.
Patrolling Commercial Bay; commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete; heading up Customs Street.
Customs Street all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check on the guard at Auckland Harbour Suites hotel, no issues to report.
Fort Street and Wilson Carpark full sweeps complete, all clear, no issues to report. On standby at Imperial Lane in case of any nearby calls.
No issues to report at this time.
Full sweep of High Street, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Freyberg Square and Chancery Square; on standby showing security presence.
All clear at Freyberg Square and Chancery Square, no issues to report.
Welfare check at Red Radisson; on standby showing security presence.
Lorne Street all clear, no issues to report; Library all clear.
Upper Queen Street all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, no issues to report; on standby showing security presence.
No issues at McDonald's Queen Street at this time; heading back to HQ for a 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ; on standby for any calls while having the break.
Break ended; on standby charging the Ops Phone, which is on a low percentage.
No calls; night shift concluded, handover complete.

flags: CAPACITY: Morning Shift second guard arrived late (08:35); patrols did not commence until 08:40 — team on HQ standby from the start of shift, available for calls only.
